subject: general
question: Who among the following was the recipient of Bharat Ratna in 2019?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Nanaji Deshmukh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nanaji Deshmukh** was a prominent Indian social activist and politician.
 
• He was a member of the **Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS)** and played a significant role in the **Jana Sangh**, which later became the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).
 
• Deshmukh was known for his work in the field of **education and rural development**.
 
• He established the **Deendayal Research Institute** in Chitrakoot, which focuses on rural development, health, and education.
 
• In recognition of his contributions to society, he was awarded the **Bharat Ratna**, India's highest civilian award, in **2019**.
 
• Nanaji Deshmukh's work has had a lasting impact on improving the lives of people in rural India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Rajeshwar Acharya**__

 __
 
• Rajeshwar Acharya is a renowned Indian classical vocalist.
 
• He specializes in the Hindustani classical music tradition.
 
• Acharya has been awarded the Padma Shri for his contributions to music.
 
 
 
• **Teejan Bai**__
 __
 
• Teejan Bai is a famous Pandavani folk singer from Chhattisgarh, India.
 
• She has been honored with the Padma Vibhushan, India's second-highest civilian award.
 
 
 
• **Virat Kohli**__
 
 
• Virat Kohli is a prominent Indian cricketer and former captain of the Indian national team.
 
• He is widely regarded as one of the best batsmen in the world.
 
• Kohli has received several awards, including the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna and the Padma Shri.
